name: chartist-kennington-common-rally
description: Chartists massed south of the Thames to march a vast petition for the vote to Parliament, but were turned back by the authorities.

name: trafalgar-square-bloody-sunday
description: Unemployed workers and radicals marching on London's central square were broken up by police and soldiers.

name: coxeys-army-march-washington
description: Jobless men led by an Ohio businessman marched to the capital to demand public works jobs during a deep depression.

name: woman-suffrage-procession-washington
description: Thousands of women marched down Pennsylvania Avenue for the vote on the eve of a presidential inauguration, facing hostile crowds.

name: petrograd-womens-day-protest
description: Women textile workers took to the streets for bread and peace, and the unrest grew until the tsar fell.

name: first-national-hunger-march
description: Unemployed men from across Britain walked to London to demand work and relief, starting a tradition of long marches.

name: sacco-vanzetti-worldwide-protests
description: Demonstrations in cities across the world demanded clemency for two Italian-born anarchists facing execution in Massachusetts.

name: bonus-army-march-washington
description: Thousands of jobless First World War veterans camped in the capital to demand early payment of their service bonuses.

name: jarrow-march
description: Two hundred unemployed shipyard men walked from a northern English town to London carrying a petition for work.

name: rosenstrasse-protest-berlin
description: Non-Jewish wives gathered outside a Berlin building for days until their detained Jewish husbands were released.

name: bengali-language-movement-protests
description: Students in Dhaka defied a ban on assemblies to demand official status for their mother tongue, and police fired on them.

name: first-aldermaston-march
description: Campaigners walked for four days from London to a nuclear weapons research site, debuting the peace symbol.

name: anpo-protests-japan
description: Huge crowds surrounded the parliament in Tokyo to oppose a revised security treaty with the United States.

name: greenham-common-womens-march
description: Women walked from Wales to a Berkshire airbase and set up a peace camp against cruise missiles.

name: battle-of-seattle-wto-protests
description: Tens of thousands blockaded a global trade summit, bringing the anti-globalisation movement to world attention.

name: global-anti-iraq-war-protests
description: Millions marched in hundreds of cities worldwide on one weekend in the largest coordinated demonstration in history.

name: occupy-wall-street
description: Protesters camped in a New York park against inequality under the slogan We are the 99 percent, inspiring camps worldwide.

name: hong-kong-umbrella-movement
description: Demonstrators with umbrellas against pepper spray occupied main roads for weeks demanding free elections.

name: womens-march-2017
description: Millions in Washington and cities across the world marched in pink hats the day after a presidential inauguration.

name: woman-life-freedom-protests
description: The death of a young woman in police custody over a headscarf sparked nationwide street protests across her country.
